name: Terrance B. Lettsome International Airport
before:
The main airport for the British Virgin Islands, and the arrival point for almost every island in the territory. Most clients land here and take a ferry onward to the smaller islands, so factor the boat into the transfer.

It is not on Tortola itself. The airport sits on Beef Island, a small island joined to Tortola by the Queen Elizabeth II Bridge.

Jet service is a recent and hard won thing. A single jet route to Miami ran briefly in 1986, a later attempt never flew at all, and it was June 2023 before American Airlines began non-stop Embraer 175 flights to Miami. That started as one seasonal daily service and has since grown to several a day.

The airport was rebuilt in 2004 in a 55 million dollar programme, the largest capital project the territory had undertaken at the time, which dredged and extended the runway by 3,700 feet and added a 46,000 square foot terminal, a new control tower and 150 parking spaces.

There is a 20 dollar departure tax for everyone over the age of five.
after:
The main airport for the British Virgin Islands. Many clients land here and take a ferry onward to the smaller islands, so factor the boat into the transfer.

The airport is on Beef Island and serves Tortola.

American Airlines has flown non-stop from Miami since June 2023.

Passengers flying out pay 50 US dollars in departure charges: a 15 dollar departure tax, a 5 dollar security fee and a 30 dollar airport development fee. These are usually included in the ticket price.
